title: decode.rs filename parsing uses manual iterator-advancing instead of split/skip — hard to read
description: uuencoding/src/decode.rs lines 75-104: the filename extraction code manually advances a byte slice 'it' through two tokens using position() and slice operations. This is ~25 lines to do what split_once could do in 5. Suggested rewrite: let rest = begin_line.splitn(3, |b: &u8| b.is_ascii_whitespace()).nth(2).unwrap_or(b""); filename = String::from_utf8_lossy(rest).into_owned(); The current code is not wrong but it required re-reading to understand, which is a signal it can be simplified.
acceptance_criteria: Rewrite the filename extraction in decode.rs to use splitn or equivalent, reducing the block to ~5 lines.
close_reason: Refactored filename extraction in uuencoding/src/decode.rs to use a skip_token helper, reducing from ~25 to ~10 lines
